Container.Name: AMP-v3
Container.Overview: Community-maintained AMP 3 beta container for Linux/amd64. Requires a CubeCoders licence. The panel and game servers run together inside this container. Official packages are extracted during the image build; first startup prepares persistent data as the amp account. The setup link is printed in container logs while initial setup is pending; keep it private. Data is stored in /opt/cubecoders/amp3/data. Native game servers require systemd and writable cgroups. The image does not change host sysctls. Container startup has been reported on Unraid; full game-server lifecycle testing is pending. Each game requires its own TCP/UDP port mappings.
Container.License: Repository code, templates and metadata: MIT. AMP software and branding: separate CubeCoders terms.

Config.Name: AMP panel port
Config.Description: Host port for the AMP web panel. Container port remains 8443.

Config.Name: AMP 3 data
Config.Description: Persistent AMP state and game-server data. A dedicated AMP 3 directory is required.

Config.Name: Systemd cgroups
Config.Description: Required writable cgroup mount for systemd and the AMP system agent.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Container time zone, for example America/Denver.

Config.Name: Internal panel port
Config.Description: Internal AMP port. Must match the container port in the panel mapping and WebUI.
